name: Fire Aspect
description: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of fire that damages enemies and sets them on fire for a short time.
tier_1: Wave deals 35% of weapon damage and sets mobs on fire for a short time.
tier_2: Wave deals 45% of weapon damage and sets mobs on fire for a short time.
tier_3: Wave deals 50% of weapon damage and sets mobs on fire for a short time.

name: Frost Crescent
description: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of ice that damages enemies and freezes them for a short time, slowing their attacks and movement.
tier_1: Wave deals 10% of weapon damage and freezes mobs for a short time, slowing their attacks and movement.
tier_2: Wave deals 15% of weapon damage and freezes mobs for a short time, slowing their attacks and movement.
tier_3: Wave deals 20% of weapon damage and freezes mobs for a short time, slowing their attacks and movement.

name: Lightning Surge
description: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of lightning that damages enemies and zaps them for a short time, making them weaker but faster.
tier_1: Wave deals 60% of weapon damage and zaps mobs for a short time, making them weaker but faster.
tier_2: Wave deals 75% of weapon damage and zaps mobs for a short time, making them weaker but faster.
tier_3: Wave deals 90% of weapon damage and zaps mobs for a short time, making them weaker but faster.

name: Poison Fog
description: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of poison that damages enemies and poisons them for a short time.
tier_1: Wave deals 10% of weapon damage and poisons mobs for a time.
tier_2: Wave deals 20% of weapon damage and poisons mobs for a time.
tier_3: Wave deals 30% of weapon damage and poisons mobs for a time.

name: Soul Blast
description: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of souls that damages enemies and deals additional soul damage over time.
tier_1: Wave deals 50% of weapon damage and deals additional soul damage over time.
tier_2: Wave deals 60% of weapon damage and deals additional soul damage over time.
tier_3: Wave deals 75% of weapon damage and deals additional soul damage over time.

name: Swirling
description: Weapon attacks unleash a swirl of air which deals additional damage to nearby enemies.
tier_1: Swirl deals an additional 50% of weapon damage to nearby enemies.
tier_2: Swirl deals an additional 75% of weapon damage to nearby enemies.
tier_3: Swirl deals an additional 100% of weapon damage to nearby enemies.

name: Crash Landing
description: Jump attacks cause an impact that deals additional damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back.
tier_1: Jump attack landings deal 5% additional damage and increases knockback by 125%.
tier_2: Jump attack landings deal 5% additional damage and increases knockback by 175%.
tier_3: Jump attack landings deal 5% additional damage and increases knockback by 200%.

name: Shielding Smite
description: Defeating an enemy has a chance to create a well that grants you and your allies the Fortifying status, protecting you from enemies.
tier_1: Defeating an enemy has a 10% chance to create a Fortifying well for allies.
tier_2: Defeating an enemy has a 20% chance to create a Fortifying well for allies.
tier_3: Defeating an enemy has a 40% chance to create a Fortifying well for allies.

name: Ender Mines
description: Weapon attacks deploy End crystals that explode in proximity to enemies or after a short time.
tier_1: Weapon attacks deploy 2 mines that explode in proximity to enemies or after a short time.
tier_2: Weapon attacks deploy 3 mines that explode in proximity to enemies or after a short time.
tier_3: Weapon attacks deploy 4 mines that explode in proximity to enemies or after a short time.

name: Healing Smite
description: Defeating an enemy has a chance to create a well that grants allies the Regenerating status, restoring their health.
tier_1: Defeating an enemy has a 20% chance to create a Regenerating well for allies.
tier_2: Defeating an enemy has a 35% chance to create a Regenerating well for allies.
tier_3: Defeating an enemy has a 50% chance to create a Regenerating well for allies.
sources: Enchantment quest|"Training With The Enchantsmith" Quest

name: Shadowcloak
description: Defeating an enemy has a chance to grant Shadowcloaking, making you invisible to enemies.
tier_1: Grants a 15% chance to enter Shadowcloaking when defeating enemies.
tier_2: Grants a 20% chance to enter Shadowcloaking when defeating enemies.
tier_3: Grants a 35% chance to enter Shadowcloaking when defeating enemies.

name: Shockwave
description: Jump attacks and final hits create a shockwave that damages enemies and knocks them back.
tier_1: Shockwave deals 20% of weapon damage and increases knockback by 25%.
tier_2: Shockwave deals 35% of weapon damage and increases knockback by 50%.
tier_3: Shockwave deals 50% of weapon damage and increases knockback by 75%.

name: Tempo Theft
description: Defeating an enemy has a chance to grant the Hurrying status, increasing movement speed for a short time.
tier_1: Grants a 30% chance to increase movement speed when defeating enemies.
tier_2: Grants a 40% chance to increase movement speed when defeating enemies.
tier_3: Grants a 50% chance to increase movement speed when defeating enemies.

name: Thundering
description: Attacks have a chance to spread lightning damage to nearby enemies.
tier_1: Grants a 25% chance for 15% of weapon damage to spread as lightning damage.
tier_2: Grants a 33% chance for 30% of weapon damage to spread as lightning damage.
tier_3: Grants a 50% chance for 50% of weapon damage to spread as lightning damage.

name: Chain Reaction
description: Successful ranged hits have a chance to fire off additional projectiles at nearby enemies.
tier_1: Projectiles have a 20% chance to spawn 4 additional projectiles.
tier_2: Projectiles have a 30% chance to spawn 6 additional projectiles.
tier_3: Projectiles have a 40% chance to spawn 8 additional projectiles.

name: Piercing
description: Allows fired arrows and projectiles to pierce through multiple targets.
tier_1: Projectiles can pierce up to 1 enemies.
tier_2: Projectiles can pierce up to 3 enemies.
tier_3: Projectiles can pierce up to 5 enemies.

name: Ricochet
description: Allows fired arrows and projectiles to bounce between multiple targets.
tier_1: Projectiles can bounce up to 1 times.
tier_2: Projectiles can bounce up to 2 times.
tier_3: Projectiles can bounce up to 3 times.

name: Ancient Alchemy
description: Using a health potion grants additional souls
tier_1: 30 Souls
tier_2: 45 Souls
tier_3: 60 Souls

name: Artifact Amplifier
description: Reduces artifact cooldown and improves damage and souls absorbed for a short time
tier_1: 6s
tier_3: 9s

name: Barrier Brew
description: Grants the Fortifying status for a short time
tier_1: 2s
tier_2: 4s
tier_3: 6s

name: Bottomless Brew
description: Gives the player additional health potions
sources: Obtained from dungeons in the sift

name: Buddy Brew
description: Chance to spawn a regeneration well for a short time
tier_1: 2s
tier_2: 4s
tier_3: 6s

name: End quiver
description: Increases max quiver size

name: Tumbleshot
description: Rolling fires a barrage of arrows targeting enemies.
tier_1: 1 arrow for 110% of range damage
tier_2: 1 arrow for 120% of range damage
tier_3: 2 arrows for 130% of range damage
